item.title: MFA debuts ‘Divine Color: Hindu Prints from Modern Bengal’ exhibition, featuring rare Indian lithographs
item.description: Mass-produced and inexpensive, Hindu prints are often overlooked by the art world as merely souvenirs or “calendar art.” But a new Museum of Fine Arts exhibition asks visitors to take a closer look.

item.title: The art of ‘Hamnet’
item.description: Chloé Zhao’s “Hamnet” sits at the top of my list for best films released in 2025, despite how late into the year it was released. This is also despite how late I watched it.
